candidates.change_summary: Delete the require that checks msg.value == 1 ether, allowing lockInGuess to be called without sending 1 ether.
Replace the require that checks msg.value == 1 ether with a require that checks msg.value == 0, changing the required payment.
Replace guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 1 with guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 2, changing the block at which settlement can occur.
Insert a statement that increments the block number by an additional 1 before assignment, delaying settlement by one extra block.
Replace the hash assignment to assign a constant value instead of the parameter, so the stored guess is always the same.
Replace the block assignment to set block to 0 instead of block.number + 1, leaving the guess in an unsettable state.
In the transfer call, replace 2 ether with 1 ether so the amount paid on a correct guess changes.
Replace the answer computation with a constant zero bytes32 so only a zero guess can succeed.
Delete the assignment that resets block to 0, allowing multiple settlements from the same guess.
Replace blockhash with keccak256 of the block number so the correct guess changes.
Change the balance require to 1 ether so a user can drain the contract below the original threshold.
Insert a selfdestruct call so the contract is destroyed when a correct guess is settled, changing subsequent behavior.
Replace the blockHash source with the current block number so the answer derivation changes.
